summary: Full reader redesign regression on 390x844 mobile web. Backend cutout endpoint returns 200 image/png (316x316 RGBA, all 4 corners alpha=0 => transparent). Frontend presentation order verified via bounding boxes: cover-card(top=16,h=246,bottom=262) -> cover-title(top=274, gap=12 below card, no overlap) -> reader-intro-eyebrow(354, text 'INTRODUCTION') -> deep-dive-hook(377) -> story-info-grid(501) -> deep-dive-start(641,bottom=701, fully visible < vp 844). Info grid: for kind/category/time, order label < icon < value confirmed; values 'CURIOSITY', 'Human body', '4 min'. Category icon rendered by expo-image (DIV wrapper with inner ) whose src is https://.../api/category-media/corpo-umano?v=colorful-3d-v3&delivery=colorful-3d-v3&cutout=true (contains cutout=true). Time icon is the local 3D clock image asset. No halo/glow behind icons detected. Paging: scroll container height=844; all 8 pages (intro, chapter-1..6, end) each have height 844. Tapping deep-dive-start scrolls to chapter 1 and header label becomes '1 OF 6'. Programmatic scroll to last page reveals like-button, bookmark-button, share-story, next-story, all visible. Mini-lesson /deep-dive/v4-lez-densita presentation shows STORY TYPE 'MINI LESSON'. Home -> story card -> reader -> back returns to /discover. No React/Reanimated console errors and no page errors. Deprecation warnings detected: 'textShadow*' style props (RN Web), and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' -- reported below.

integration_issues.issue: Programmatic scrollTo(2*pageH) on [data-testid=deep-dive-scroll] did not update the header 'N OF M' label within 1.2s in this run (label read back as null via full-text scan). Visual scrolling to the end still shows correct chapter/end content and all end buttons; taps on deep-dive-start still update to '1 OF 6'. This is a web-only nuance because Animated.ScrollView's Reanimated scroll handler may not fire for programmatic scrollTo without a synthetic event. Native fling smoothness cannot be verified on web (per agent-to-agent context) - reporting for awareness only.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' console warning on reader. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/reader-cover-backdrop.tsx:59 (pointerEvents="none" on Animated.View) and /app/frontend/src/components/story-info-grid.tsx:36,44 (pointerEvents="none" on LinearGradient). Move to style.pointerEvents.

'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'. Emitted by RN Web. Sources: /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx:381 (coverTitle), :389 (introDot boxShadow ok), :392 (introEyebrow), :397 (hook) using textShadowColor/Offset/Radius. Migrate to unified 'textShadow' shorthand.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents in reader-cover-backdrop.tsx and story-info-grid.tsx.
Optional cleanup: migrate textShadow* style props to the unified 'textShadow' string in deep-dive/[id].tsx styles (coverTitle/introEyebrow/hook).
critical_code_review_comments: deep-dive/[id].tsx wires all required testIDs and places the title BELOW the cover card via a separate heroTitleWrap after coverArea; gap measured at 12px (title top 274, card bottom 262).

story-info-grid.tsx renders label ABOVE the icon and value BELOW; category cell uses CategoryArtMark with plain=true and transparent backgroundColor - the emitted URL contains cutout=true so the backend returns the cut-out PNG.

reader-page.tsx sets its outer View to height=pageH (equal to Animated.ScrollView clientHeight measured on layout), so every page in [data-testid=deep-dive-scroll] is exactly one screen tall (verified: all 8 children == 844).
Reader has no runtime errors; only deprecation warnings for RN Web textShadow* and pointerEvents props.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of required checks (presentation order, info grid order/values, category cutout src, paging structure, chapter navigation on tap, end page buttons, mini-lesson, home->reader->back)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reader paging on Expo web: scroll container is [data-testid=deep-dive-scroll] with clientHeight == page height (844 on 390x844). Programmatic scrollTo may not trigger Reanimated onScroll reliably on web; tapping deep-dive-start does update section state (header shows 'N OF M'). To verify chapter N on web, prefer clicking deep-dive-start and then scrolling by discrete pageH multiples with a short delay, and read chapter content via [data-testid=deep-dive-page-chapter-N]. Category cutout URL pattern: /api/category-media/{catId}?v=colorful-3d-v3&delivery=colorful-3d-v3&cutout=true; the inner inside the DIV wrapper carries the src.
